REGISTRATION AND ADMISSION
The registration of a student seeking admission does not necessarily entitle the student
for conﬁrmation.
The name of the applicant will be registered on receipt of the application for admission
duly completed Filled in application can be sent to the school address along with

duly completed Filled in application can be sent to the school address along with
the account payee cheque for Rs. 5200/- towards registration in favour of Lala
Kamlapat Singhania Education Centre, payable at UCO Bank, Gotan / SBI Bank,
Gotan or in cash.
Date of birth, as recorded in the previous school leaving certiﬁcates countersigned by the
District Education Oﬃcer of the state will be considered ﬁnal and no application for
change in the date of birth will subsequently be entertained.
Parents and guardians must, therefore, ensure that these entries are made correctly in
the admission form.

ADMISSION TO CLASS XI
Students  seeking  admission  to  class  XI (Humanities,  Commerce  and
Science  streams)  should  get  their  names  registered  and  send  an
attested  copy  of  the  marks -sheet  of  class  X Board  Examination  within
a week  of  the  declaration  of  the  result . Admission  to  class  XI is made
on  the  basis  of  admission  test  conducted  in  the  school  in  the  last
week  of  March,  every  year . The Principal  reserves  the  right  to  accept
or  reject  any  application  for  admission  without  assigning  any  reason .
Application  for  registration  cum  admission  should  be  sent  to
Principal,  L K Singhania Education  Centre,  Gotan, 342902 (Raj.)

SCHOOL RULES
LEAVE RULES
To maintain a safe and secure environment, parents/guardians must follow our leave
policy. Before taking their child on leave, they must obtain prior approval from the
Principal and collect a gate pass from the concerned Hostel In-charge. Failure to
comply with this policy may result in disciplinary action and potential legal consequences.
This policy applies to all instances, including when parents/guardians are staying in
our school guest house.

Parents/guardians are to abide by the school rules in all respects which are subjected
to change from time to time. In all matters of dispute, the decision of the Principal
shall be binding and ﬁnal.

VALUABLES
To maintain a distraction-free and secure environment, we prohibit boarders from
possessing cell phones, smart watches, and valuable items. Please note that the school
will not be liable for any loss or damage to personal belongings.
To maintain a safe and inclusive environment, we have a no-food parcel policy and
discourage expensive birthday parties. Instead, parents can notify us, and we will
arrange a modest celebration with a cake and sweets for the student's closest friends,

, and we will
arrange a modest celebration with a cake and sweets for the student's closest friends,
coordinated by the housemaster. Please note that Amazon deliveries / online shopping
will only be accepted with prior permission from the respective House Master. Students
and parents must obtain approval before placing an order.
FOOD PARCELS
We look forward to welcoming parents and local guardians on the second Sunday of
every month For outstation parents, advance notice of the visit is requested to facilitate
the necessary arrangements for accommodation in the school guest house. Additionally,
a parental authorization letter is required to be carried for veriﬁcation purpose.

MONETARY AND OTHER TRANSACTIONS
The school is committed to providing a safe and secure environment for our students.
We will provide an escort for large groups of students travelling from the same location
However, parents are responsible for arranging their child's transportation to and
from school at the beginning and end of each term. Please note that we require written
parental authorization for students to leave school unescorted.

About the
School
Established as a full-fledged residential school in July 1987, the LK Singhania Education Centre is the
realisation of the vision and values of the great philanthropist, Late Lala Kamlapat Singhania. What
began in 1984 as a school for the children of JK White Cement employees has, through the commitment of
the JK Organisation, grown into a premier Senior Secondary, co-educational, English-medium institution,

JK Organisation, grown into a premier Senior Secondary, co-educational, English-medium institution,
affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), New Delhi. Today, the Centre
accommodates nearly 1,650 students, including 950 boarders from across India and abroad, truly making it
a multicultural community.
